# Fixing a flat tyre on a bicycle

## What you need

Two tyre levers, a patch kit with sandpaper and glue, and a pump that fits your valve.

## Steps

Take the wheel off and push the levers under the tyre bead to lift one side off the rim. Pull out
the inner tube and pump it up a little to hear where the air escapes. Roughen the area, spread a
thin layer of glue, wait one minute and press the patch for thirty seconds. Check the inside of
the tyre for the thorn or glass that caused the puncture before you put everything back.
